description: add_tag() uses a mutable default argument that is shared between calls.

issue.title: Tags from one item show up on another
issue.body:
After adding a tag to one catalogue item, items created later come back with that tag too.
For example adding `red` to a shirt and then `blue` to a hat gives the hat both `red` and
`blue`. Calling `add_tag` without a list seems to share state between calls.
